notes: ZERO FIELDS IS THE CORRECT ANSWER AND I AM STATING IT EXPLICITLY: the configuration surface of the Budget Configuration page (/expense/admin/invoice/budgetConfiguration.asp) HAS NO DOCUMENTARY BASIS IN THIS CORPUS. THE CORPUS DEFERS TO AN EXTERNAL GUIDE NAMED 'Shared: Budget Setup Guide', WHICH IS NOT PRESENT HERE (this corpus is Concur Invoice Professional Edition only). That deferral is stated three separate times, in budget-approval-59251c3b.md ('For more information about budget approval and budget workflows, refer to the _Shared: Budget Setup Guide_.'), in approver-terminology-8559861c.md for the Budget Approver role, and in both copies of add-a-custom-audit-rule (0f1d320e / 43e3f9aa) at the exact point where budget notification fields would have been enumerated. WHAT I SEARCHED (both guide dirs AND both release-note dirs, all 2230 files): the literal strings 'Budget Configuration' and 'budgetConfiguration' return ZERO hits corpus-wide; so do 'Budget Admin', 'Budget Item', 'Budget Manager', 'Budget Viewer', 'Budget Category', 'Manage Budget'. A nav-shape search for '> Budget' or 'Budget >' returns zero, so there is NO navigation path to record. The two release-note directories contain ZERO occurrences of 'budget' in any form - that negative corroborates the absence rather than dating a UI variant, and no release note is cited as a sourceFile. LENS-C SPECIFIC FINDING - I EXHAUSTED TOOLS-GUIDES FIRST, AND THE RECON INVENTORY MISSED IT: recon listed no tools-guides files at all, but six tools-guides files do contain the token 'budget'. I read all six and every one is INCIDENTAL COMMON-NOUN PROSE, not the Budget feature: create-and-manage-allocation-favorites-4d3a7e54 and -22cb2e7c ('correctly identify and budget the expense to the accounting system', a verb); distribute-allocate-a-purchase-request-689dbc62 ('managing departmental budgets'); select-for-different-vendors-and-project-and-event-based-requests-1f3c9d5b ('budget appropriate'); understand-conditional-expressions-db3d7418 ('AmountRemaining for EuropeBudget', an invented example group name inside an audit-rule expression); workflow-and-approval-routing-8b4ff6c9 (a best-practice note about routing large PO-based invoices to give an approver 'budget insight' - Workflows advice, not a budget control). NONE yields a field, a value, or a role gate for this page. So the tools-guides skew this lens exists to correct genuinely has nothing to contribute here, which is itself the finding. NO REQUIRED-ROLES, LIMITATIONS, PREREQUISITES, IMPORT/EXPORT RECORD-LAYOUT, OR INTEGRATION TOPIC FOR THIS PAGE EXISTS IN EITHER GUIDE DIRECTORY. The single prerequisite-shaped statement anywhere is provisioning, not configuration: 'The Budget feature is a purchased service.' UI VARIANT: left 'undifferentiated'. I searched 'new experience', 'new ui', 'legacy', and 'current user interface' against every budget-bearing file and found no variant evidence; with zero documented controls there is nothing to have read twice, so a 'both' claim would be unearned - I am not adding a fourth. RAW <table> CENSUS: zero <table> elements in any budget-bearing file, so no HTML-table catalog was missed. WHAT I COULD NOT DETERMINE: everything about this page's actual controls - whether it has budget name, budget type, period type, control/alert limit, or owner fields; whether the Condition-page operand names mirror on-page field labels (plausible, and therefore forbidden to assume); what roles gate it; and where it hangs in the nav tree.
